items.t: What Investors Got Wrong About Sunrun Before A 65% Slide
items.sum: If you had backed Sunrun at the very start of 2026, the ride since has been rough. Holding Sunrun from the start of the year would have meant a 65.3% loss, including dividends. That outcome jars with the bullish August 2025 pitch, which was built on 20.9% annual revenue growth, a swing from steep losses to a 43.8% profit margin, and a 5.1x P/E on 2028 earnings.
